title: Re-point the macos-14 arm64 runner to macos-15 before the image is retired (2026-11-02)
description: GitHub retires the macOS 14 runner images on 2026-11-02 and fails every macos-14 job in scheduled brownouts before that (actions/runner-images issue 13518). The darwin-arm64 leg of prepublication-qualification.yml (runs-on macos-14) was cancelled by a brownout on the v0.15.0 tag run 41321796131, so no candidate-bundle or native-execution-receipt exists for that tag. The workflow runs at the tag ref, so the tag cannot be qualified without a fixed workflow on the commit it names. Fleet scan (leader, 2026-11-01): macos-14 appears only in prepublication-qualification.yml:126 and projection-platform.yml:38,40 in this repository. macos-15 is arm64; macos-15-intel stays the x64 leg. CI-workflow edit on the release path: DEC-182 (1), floor and Opus review before commit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No workflow file in the repository names macos-14: prepublication-qualification.yml and projection-platform.yml run the darwin-arm64 leg on macos-15
The projection-platform matrix keeps one job per (platform, arch) with distinct names
The change lands under a fresh Opus review at the final head, and source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check are green on it
